summary: Backend Refactoring Regression Test - All API routes working correctly after modular refactoring. 40/41 tests passed (97.6%). The only failure is /health at root level which returns frontend HTML (expected behavior in K8s ingress). All critical routes including auth, users, sessions, stats, challenges, groups, leaderboard, coach, parent, badges, notifications, referral, and payments are functioning correctly.

minor.issue: Returns frontend HTML instead of JSON health check. This is expected behavior as K8s ingress routes non-/api paths to frontend.

Scheduler jobs for parent notifications are properly integrated
All route modules properly imported and registered in server.py
